claims: Earth Day is celebrated annually on April 22.
Earth Day marks the anniversary of the first Earth Day in 1970.
The first Earth Day in 1970 launched the modern environmental movement.
The 2026 Earth Day theme is “Our Power, Our Planet.”
Earth Day is the largest secular, civic event in the world.
Earth Day was initiated by Senator Gaylord Nelson and Harvard student Denis Hayes in 1970.
Common Earth Day activities include planting trees.
Common Earth Day activities include cleaning up litter.
Common Earth Day activities include using eco-friendly products.
Common Earth Day activities include attending educational events.
